site.name: Veyth
site.title: Veyth — tiny tools, no tracking
site.description: Fast, private, client-side tools for developers and makers. JSON, UUID, regex, JWT & more. No tracking, no upload — everything runs in your browser.

tools.title: JSON Formatter & Validator
tools.description: Format, validate, minify & sort keys — with exact error locations, one-click fixes and a tree view. Runs 100% locally.

tools.title: UUID Generator & SHA-256 Hash
tools.description: Generate v4 & v7 UUIDs in bulk, inspect any UUID, and SHA-256/512 or HMAC hash text and files with Web Crypto.
tools.keywords: uuid generator v7 validator sha256 sha512 hmac hash

tools.title: Regex Tester
tools.description: Live match highlighting, capture groups and replace preview — with a cheat sheet and a library of common patterns.

tools.title: Base64 & URL Encoder / Decoder
tools.description: Encode and decode Base64, Base64URL, URL, Hex and HTML entities — UTF-8 safe, auto-detects encoded input.
tools.keywords: base64 encode decode url encoder hex html entities

tools.title: JWT Decoder
tools.description: Decode JSON Web Tokens and verify HS/RS/PS/ES signatures locally — claims explained. Your token never leaves the page.
tools.keywords: jwt decoder verify signature json web token

tools.title: Image Resizer & Converter
tools.description: Resize, compress and convert JPG, PNG, WebP & AVIF in bulk — or shrink to a max file size. Nothing is uploaded; EXIF/GPS data is stripped.
tools.keywords: image resizer compress image to kb reduce file size convert png to jpg webp avif converter

tools.title: Color Picker from Image
tools.description: Pick a color from any photo with a zoom dropper, then fine-tune the match in a honeycomb of nearby shades. HEX, RGB, HSL, OKLCH & CMYK — the photo is never uploaded.
tools.keywords: color picker from image eyedropper photo hex rgb hsl oklch color matcher find color code

tools.title: Bill Split & Tip Calculator
tools.description: Split a bill evenly or by what everyone ordered — tip, tax and shared dishes included, down to the exact cent. Share one link with the whole table.
tools.keywords: split the bill calculator tip calculator restaurant bill splitter who owes what split check

pages.title: About
pages.description: Why veyth.eu exists, who runs it, how the tools work and the promises it keeps: no cookies, no accounts, no uploads.

pages.title: Privacy policy
pages.description: What veyth.eu does and doesn't collect: no cookies, no analytics, no access logs. Tools run entirely in your browser.
